caption:
Do you budget for food or count at the checkout? Comment A or B.

Set a weekly shopping budget and see what your meal plan is estimated to cost. Too much? Swap a dish before you buy anything. It's an estimate from available ingredient prices, not a receipt.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.
